title: Baseline release 2026.10.7: render again (`tend baseline render --write`)
body:
+ ci.on-demand: A repo only you commit to runs its checks locally before every commit (the pre-commit hook, `tend code hook --install`) and its CI by hand (on: workflow_dispatch, `gh workflow run`), not on every push. A repo with other committers runs CI on their pull requests and on pushes to main; one whose releases others build on also runs it on its release tags.
~ env.no-secrets: No secrets in the repo: no .env files or private keys are committed.
~ env.readme: Every repo has a README that says what it is and how to run it.
+ git.no-agent-trailers: Commits carry no agent or session trailers (a Co-Authored-By naming an agent, Claude-Session, a 'Generated with' line): a commit is the user's. A DCO Signed-off-by stays where the project's license asks for one.
~ js.bun: JavaScript projects use bun and bunx, never npm, npx, yarn or pnpm (no npm, yarn or pnpm lockfiles).
~ rust.lockfile: Binaries and workspaces commit Cargo.lock.
~ rust.toolchain-pinned: A Rust project pins its toolchain (and components) in rust-toolchain.toml.
~ tests.with-features: Every feature ships with tests at the right level; they run before every commit, and in CI where the repo runs it.
